339-574-677-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
339-574-677-4068.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-4068.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2023-2079-4770-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1116-2033-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1116-2033-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

645-1267-3908-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-3908-8095.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Spark Double.
Spark Double triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Spark Double
Repeat each turn.

710-2961-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-5131-7054-8095--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-7054-8095--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5686-6823.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-6823.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

618-2921-3305.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Body Launderer with haste.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki.
When Kiki-Jiki dies, each Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing them to each connive.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the token Body Launderer.
When the Body Launderer token dies, its second ability triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4399-4506-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Auriok Champion trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Auriok Champion trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4506-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

129-1409-3755-7297.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

3784-4091-7791.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that can't be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Vhal.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Vhal.
Repeat.

1368-1563-6321-7296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1563-6321-7296.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5231-5571-7666--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

439-643-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to Arashin Sovereign's power, which will cause you to mill Arashin Sovereign.
As Arashin Sovereign is a Lhurgoyf due to Maskwood Nexus, Disa's first ability triggers, returning Arashin Sovereign from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-2376--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat

2228-2335-7325.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic's first ability by tapping it.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mighty Mutanimals triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Barrenton Medic.
Resolve the Barrenton Medic ability from step 2, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-3497-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 3 life this turn.
413-3497-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
When Tatterkite enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

546-4613-5900-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least five tapped lands on the battlefield.
546-4613-5900-7232.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Ignition Team. Ignition Team enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Ignition Team using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1029-2113-7010.description:
Activate Gran-Gran by tapping it, adding {1}.
Gran-Gran triggers, causing you to loot.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Gran-Gran.
Repeat.

49-944-2034-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

414-2169-4613.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
414-2169-4613.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 2 using the Insect token instead.

2893-3875-5455-5478.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1456-5344-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
1456-5344-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

3564-4275-5147-5329.easyPrerequisites: You control another untapped nontoken Merfolk.
3564-4275-5147-5329.description:
Activate Kumena's first ability by tapping another nontoken Merfolk you control.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kumena ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Merfolk token.
When the Merfolk dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all Merfolk.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.
3564-4275-5147-5329.notes: You can tap as many nontoken Merfolk as able each iteration by repeating steps 1 through 3 for each Merfolk. They will all be untapped by Faces of the Past.

141-997-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {4}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-997-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

876-1170-1329-1492.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
876-1170-1329-1492.description:
If needed, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Emry.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Welding Jar from your graveyard.
Cast Welding Jar by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3011-3231-4090.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
3011-3231-4090.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to half their life total, rounded down, times 2, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.
3011-3231-4090.notes: If the opponents have an odd life total, they will have 1 life remaining. If they have an even life total, they will have 0 life and lose the game.

5220-5231-6766.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
5220-5231-6766.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2866-4970-5751-6747--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

2645-5115-6602.notablePrerequisites: You have had six nontoken creatures enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
2645-5115-6602.description:
Activate Tromell by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put at least six charge counters on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array six times by removing six charge counters from it, adding six mana of any color(s).
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Tromell.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1742-2557-2793-3743-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1742-2557-2793-3743-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

4275-5470-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
4275-5470-5686.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat from step 2.

290-1978-5793.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat.

1050-1329-2046.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1050-1329-2046.description:
Activate Nevinyrral's Disk by paying {1} and tapping it, destroying all artifacts, creatures and enchantments.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Nevinyrral's Disk.
Cast Nevinyrral's Disk from your graveyard by paying {4}.
Repeat during each of your turns.

4231-4321-5231-5270-5682.description:
Cast Astrid by paying {1}{W}.
When Astrid enters the battlefield, its first ability and Samwise Gamgee trigger.
Resolve the Astrid trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Samwise Gamgee trigger, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Astrid, adding {R}.
Activate Samwise Gamgee by sacrificing three Foods, returning Astrid from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1350-2598-2793-4659.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying the Ugin's Nexus spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve both Ugin's Nexus spells.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Ugin's Nexus token, adding {C}{C}.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning the nontoken Ugin's Nexus to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

141-313-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-4050.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

371-1322-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Forests.
371-1322-5003.description:
Activate five Forests by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Llanowar Druid by tapping and sacrificing it.
Llanowar Druid dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Llanowar Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Llanowar Druid ability from step 2, untapping all Forests.
Repeat.

1261-1978-5089.description:
Activate Karn's +2 ability, turning Time Vault into a 1/1 creature until end of turn.
Activate Voltaic Construct for {2}, untapping Time Vault.
Tap Time Vault to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.
